elements.name: controlGroup
elements.label: New provider control resource group
elements.toolTip: Contains the API, worker, management portal and private state. Use a new dedicated group.

elements.name: dataGroup
elements.label: New provider dataplane resource group
elements.toolTip: Provider networking for customer environments is created here later. Lab NSGs allow all traffic; public VM IPs can expose listening services.

elements.name: apiId
elements.label: Provider API application (client) ID
elements.toolTip: From the provider Entra API app registration, not a customer identity.

elements.name: apiRole
elements.label: FirewallDeployment.Request application role ID
elements.toolTip: The ID of the Applications role defined on the provider API.

elements.name: managementId
elements.label: Provider management application (client) ID
elements.toolTip: The separate provider Entra app with explicitly granted Graph permissions.

elements.name: managementSecret
elements.toolTip: The one-time provider setup credential, not a customer's API credential.

elements.name: managementExpiry
elements.label: Management credential expiry (UTC)
elements.toolTip: Use the expiration shown in Entra, for example 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z.

elements.name: administrator
elements.label: Provider administrator user object ID
elements.toolTip: The provider-tenant user's Object ID, not application ID or email.

elements.name: sshKey
elements.label: Provider NVA SSH public key
elements.toolTip: OpenSSH PUBLIC key only. Never enter a private key.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid OpenSSH public key.

elements.name: approveBacking
elements.label: I approve the deployment-script backing storage exception and provider infrastructure charges

constraints.validationMessage: Approval is required for the provider installation.
